verdict.rationale: Kushki is API-first for payment operations. Its docs cover API flows for charges, authorization and capture, refunds and voids, recurring and scheduled charges, and a fully API-based 3DS integration. Nothing in the pack states or demonstrates that the merchant console/UI functions all have API equivalents, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented API–dashboard parity statement, API coverage of console/admin functions (users, settings, reporting, Smartlink/link management), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
